# Candidate held-out cells for the compositional split (generated by scripts/hgo/cg_cells.py)

Partner conflict: PET < 3.0 s and the ego reaches the conflict point within 6.0 s (logged path, contiguous future ≤ 10 s), the partner's trajectory crosses the ego path. Maneuver: man10, turns only inside an intersection (else 'curve'). Test = navtest scenes (strict cell). Purge = inclusive rule over t0 and the next 8 frames. Power: paired difference H32 − DrivoR on the test cell (official per-scene EPDMS); mde80 = 2.8 × max(SE paired, SE log bootstrap), in EPDMS points.
